item: Strikes repository attach; IaC #34 to #37; one place for Dinis's questions; an editor-in-chief
summary: Dinis asks for four actions: attach the strikes repository for cl-6.place.london; approve IaC #34, #35, #36 and #37; keep his questions in one place agreed with cl-6.maestro; create a top-level editor, senior to the correspondent, accountable for content.

1_strikes_attach.what: attach PrompTugal/PrompTugal__Agent__Place__London__Strikes with push to cl-6.place.london's session (session_016CrbJKifSCoGBhUJDMMjpN), for record 2026-11-27__strikes-site-publish
1_strikes_attach.note: the attach itself is done in that session (it has no add_repo, so a person approves it there); cl-6.abp's rules want a push attach confirmed in its own session; this record carries his words for cl-6.abp to weigh

2_iac_prs.what: Dinis approves merging PrompTugal/PrompTugal__IaC #34, #35, #36, #37 in that order, each at the head cl-6.security passed
conditions: merged by a person or by an agent whose grant already allows merging IaC pull requests on a record quoting Dinis
a head that moves after this record lapses this approval for that PR
merging is to dev; nothing here touches main

parts.3_one_place: Dinis's questions are kept in site/factory/dinis-cruz/account-f/questions.json in this repository, kept by cl-6.decisions (adds, dedupes, closes) and shown on cl-6.maestro's briefing page

4_editor.what: a new role cl-6.editor@PrompTugal.dinis, editor-in-chief: owner of content/** on promptugal.news and accountable for all published content, senior to the correspondent
4_editor.settles: the content/** owner question (F58, F06, F50)

authority.dinis_words: hi can you do those actions * attach strikes repo * ask the decision agent to sign and approve those IaC PRs * what do you mean by Section keys (can you sync with the maestro on the place to put these questions and info on me) * I think we need a top level editor (or a role more senior that the correspondent) to be accountable for the content
authority.checked_by_recorder: read in cl-6.conductor's transcript with list_events

reviews.verdict: IaC #34 to #37 passed at the heads above (as relayed by cl-6.conductor and cl-6.infra)
